about: Pilot scenes: one widescreen picture a pilot. close is the avatar's square (the head); side is where the pilot stands, so text goes on the other side; crops are the largest box of each aspect that keeps the pilot; chart, on a few, says the scene shows the sea on a display. Written by Tools/Build/pilot_art/scene.py manifest.

ENSIGN.name: Veliane Crestward
ENSIGN.treatment: Medium-format garden portrait at waist level, first warmth
ENSIGN.source: profession: an aristocrat who keeps a garden's sea wall by hand sits in the one gap left in it

MANGER.name: Tamako Deephook
MANGER.treatment: Field documentary, a long lens from far off
MANGER.source: profession: a hunter who wades the feeding flats sets a lure line

ANVIL.name: Brikon Copperwright
ANVIL.treatment: Industrial reportage side-on, deep focus, mid-push
ANVIL.source: profession: a dealer in heavy crystal brings a boulder of it up from the quarry by hand

VOLT.name: Karenth Amberweaver
VOLT.treatment: Workshop reportage at a slow shutter, one hand a blur
VOLT.source: profession: a dealer in lamps and the charge that lights them proves each bulb by hand before it is sold

ZODIAC.name: Ivelia Starreach
ZODIAC.treatment: Travel reportage on slow slide film, dusk in a chart house
ZODIAC.source: history: "was apprenticed to a cartographer" (the game's Upbringings)

SUNDIAL.name: Delmira Stillwater
SUNDIAL.treatment: Window-light interior on a tripod, a private moment walked in on
SUNDIAL.source: hobby: "has never once arrived early" (the game's Quirks)

OPAL.name: Quivera Pearlspark
OPAL.treatment: Deadpan colour documentary, squared-up, harsh noon
OPAL.source: hobby: "refuses to fly on an empty stomach" (the game's Quirks)

RAMPART.name: Obelo Stormstone
RAMPART.treatment: Unposed side-on documentary in a yard, storm light
RAMPART.source: want: "a quiet harbour and a long sleep" (the game's Wants)

CITADEL.name: Nedira Shellward
CITADEL.treatment: Window light in the Dutch manner, a storeroom
CITADEL.source: profession: an aristocrat whose house feeds its harbour through the winter measures out the alms grain by hand

HORNET.name: Zeko Mirethorn
HORNET.treatment: Night exterior by one hazard lamp, from a boat alongside
HORNET.source: profession: a hunter who keeps the hazard light on a danger shoal stands the night under it

IVY.name: Mathalo Kelpbloom
IVY.treatment: Botanical-survey portrait from the next bough, deadpan
IVY.source: profession: an aristocrat who keeps a hanging garden judges its one bloom of the year

TALON.name: Wyvendo Waveline
TALON.treatment: Raking-light documentary at sunrise, eye to eye
TALON.source: profession: a tracker finds, in a brickyard at sunrise, the print of what walked through town in the night

DOE.name: Fenlia Moonbell
DOE.treatment: Half-second exposure at nightfall on a tripod
DOE.source: profession: a hunter who tracks by ear stands in still water at nightfall and listens

WINGMAN.name: Jorin Gullwing
WINGMAN.treatment: Hard sea light on a cliff ledge, from a burrow's doorway
WINGMAN.source: want: "a crew that stays" (the game's Wants)

BANDIT.name: Rosh Rusthook
BANDIT.treatment: Low-tide documentary at crouch height, flat silver light
BANDIT.source: profession: a pirate at home in the den, the hoard laid out at the door, opening the day's take

NEEDLE.name: Ilia Silvergate
NEEDLE.treatment: Architectural interior with a shift lens, verticals true
NEEDLE.source: profession: an aristocrat whose house keeps a harbour's sea gate stands the last watch of the night

GALLEON.name: Haradek Anchorkeel
GALLEON.treatment: Cinematic film still, anamorphic, one work lamp
GALLEON.source: hobby: "ties a ribbon on the hull for every friend lost" (the game's Quirks)

FLUME.name: Ekora Hollowbrook
FLUME.treatment: Split-level waterline shot, half above and half below
FLUME.source: history: "grew up on a salvage barge" (the game's Upbringings)

Astrofoil.name: Astrofoil
Astrofoil.treatment: Climbing photograph from the anchor above, looking down the wall
Astrofoil.source: profession: an explorer goes past the last fixed marker, and is pleased to be caught at it

Bushy.name: Bushy
Bushy.treatment: Harvest reportage into the sun, backlit dust at golden hour
Bushy.source: profession: a gatherer winnows the day's seed on the hill floor, and the birds get the last of each basket

Comet.name: Comet
Comet.treatment: Night sports-desk photograph after the event, floodlights still on

Damsel.name: Damsel
Damsel.treatment: Morning street photograph from across the quay, caught mid-sip
Damsel.source: profession: an activist, up before the dawn walk, is caught at breakfast in a wall bloom

Dozer.name: Dozer
Dozer.treatment: Through a new pane from inside, the glazier dozing on the outside of the glass
Dozer.source: profession: a contractor glazes a great canopy from the outside, held on by sticky palms

Echo.name: Echo
Echo.treatment: Candid snapshot by a crewmate, desk-lamp light
Echo.source: hobby: "keeps a jar of every crystal they have ever missed" (the game's Quirks)

Fiest.name: Fiest
Fiest.treatment: Wide 21mm interior from the doorway, available light, a little crooked

Flux.name: Flux
Flux.treatment: Cockpit portrait from the nose, lit from below by a replay

Jugger.name: Jugger
Jugger.treatment: 65mm epic film still, deep focus, a bridge lit by its display

Krush.name: Krush
Krush.treatment: Flash snapshot by whoever came down the cellar stairs
Krush.source: hobby: "cannot resist a dare" (the game's Quirks)

Longshift.name: Longshift

Longshift.source: want: "to see the edge of the map" (the game's Wants)

Maestro.name: Maestro
Maestro.treatment: Long view down a nave on a 135mm from a tripod, candle points

Mason.name: Mason
Mason.treatment: Wall-height working frame from the seaward side, caught in the act in sea haze

Reaper.name: Reaper
Reaper.treatment: Level-tripod interior across a great shell, the wall plainly vertical

Scales.name: Scales
Scales.treatment: Formal state-occasion photograph down the length of a bridge, soft daylight
Scales.source: profession: a diplomat watches the first joint patrol fly under the treaty just signed

Tenacious.name: Tenacious
Tenacious.treatment: Aftermath portrait, medium format, eye to eye
Tenacious.source: profession: a first responder, in the first minute after a rescue

Trace.name: Trace

Spare05.name: Halven Frostgate
Spare05.treatment: Snow-light interior, large format, very still
Spare05.source: hobby: "writes letters to a sibling who never writes back" (the game's Quirks)
